title: Belgian American Education Foundation Fellowships (B.A.E.F.)
summary: For U.S. citizens or permanent residents: one academic year of advanced study or research at a Belgian higher education institution. Study in Flanders’ undated BAEF overview lists up to 10 fellowships, with $27,000 for master’s or PhD students and $31,000 for postdoctoral fellows. No application deadline or current call year is provided; confirm current terms with the linked provider.

title: Master Mind Scholarship
summary: Closed 2026–27: master’s applicants need GPA 3.5/4, English proof, host admission and nomination; all nationalities except Russian. No Flemish qualifying degree or current enrolment (except Spring 2026 preparation for September 2026). €10,225/year plus fee waiver; €136.50 tuition may remain. Year two needs 54 ECTS; its payments total €11,750, conflicting with €10,225. No combined Flemish/Erasmus/BAEF/Fulbright award. Host deadlines and arts language thresholds differ. Full criteria apply; new 2027–28 terms under review.
